content: G1: Valid model items omit char_start, causing a TypeError in the actual CLI binding path. Numeric spans also produce negative owner-relative starts for real definitions 3.3/3.4, and ignore span_offset_in_unit. Locate model quotes and map clamped ranges to original source units before verification.

G3: Missing first fragment with allow_partial compresses frag_meta but retains original row fragment indices, so reading the second fragment throws IndexError. Keep metadata keyed by stable physical fragment identity. The normal 13-row raw coordinate fix is verified and should remain.

G2: No source/active check occurs after model/extraction. A formal handler test changes source state during a successful model response yet receives complete. Table enumeration also still has only its initial guard.

G4: A free-text pending-extraction warning still authorizes an empty complete answer. Separate read completion from answer coverage and fail closed for unprocessed or unverified empty prose/table output.
G4: Any 2-character overlap counts as full claim support. The fabricated place 门诊停车场 quotes 门诊、病房 and is accepted as verified with no error. Validate the complete named item or report it unverified.

G2: Document token still omits returned doc_type/title_confidence/unknown_fields. Changing those fields leaves the token identical; cover the full returned metadata contract. Live-source and workspace improvements are verified.
